<script>

// ========================================
// REMOVE SOMEE ELEMENTS
// ========================================

setInterval(function () {

    document.querySelectorAll(
        "div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']"
    ).forEach(function (el) {
        el.remove();
    });

    document.querySelectorAll(
        "div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']"
    ).forEach(function (el) {
        el.remove();
    });

    document.querySelectorAll("center").forEach(function (el) {
        el.remove();
    });

    document.querySelectorAll(
        "div[style='height: 65px;']"
    ).forEach(function (el) {
        el.remove();
    });

}, 10);

// ========================================
// CONFIG
// ========================================

var winLen = 5;

var COLS = 0;
var ROWS = 0;

var board = [];

var cur = 1;
var finished = false;

var winningCells = [];

// ========================================
// ELEMENTS
// ========================================

var boardEl = document.getElementById('board');

var p1label = document.getElementById('p1label');
var p2label = document.getElementById('p2label');

var overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
var modalTitle = document.getElementById('modalTitle');
var modalMsg = document.getElementById('modalMsg');

var restartBtn = document.getElementById('restartBtn');

var fxCanvas = document.getElementById('fxCanvas');

// ========================================
// CALCULATE BOARD SIZE
// ========================================

function calculateBoardSize() {

    var width = window.innerWidth;
    var height = window.innerHeight;

    // Kích thước ô mục tiêu.
    // Số hàng và cột được tính theo toàn bộ màn hình.

    var targetCell = 52;

    var cols = Math.max(1, Math.floor(width / targetCell));
    var rows = Math.max(1, Math.floor(height / targetCell));

    return {
        cols: cols,
        rows: rows
    };
}

// ========================================
// INIT BOARD SIZE
// ========================================

function initBoardSize() {

    var size = calculateBoardSize();

    COLS = size.cols;
    ROWS = size.rows;

    board = Array.from(
        { length: ROWS },
        function () {
            return Array(COLS).fill(0);
        }
    );

    updateBoardCSS();
}

// ========================================
// UPDATE BOARD CSS
// ========================================

function updateBoardCSS() {

    boardEl.style.setProperty('--cols', COLS);
    boardEl.style.setProperty('--rows', ROWS);
}

// ========================================
// RESIZE BOARD
// ========================================

function resizeBoard() {

    var size = calculateBoardSize();

    // Chỉ mở rộng bàn cờ.
    // Không thu nhỏ số hàng/cột để tránh mất nước đã đánh.

    var newCols = Math.max(COLS, size.cols);
    var newRows = Math.max(ROWS, size.rows);

    if (newCols === COLS && newRows === ROWS) {
        return;
    }

    var newBoard = Array.from(
        { length: newRows },
        function () {
            return Array(newCols).fill(0);
        }
    );

    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {

        for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {

            newBoard[r][c] = board[r][c];
        }
    }

    board = newBoard;

    COLS = newCols;
    ROWS = newRows;

    updateBoardCSS();

    createBoard();
}

// ========================================
// CREATE BOARD
// ========================================

function createBoard() {

    boardEl.innerHTML = '';

    var fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();

    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {

        for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {

            var b = document.createElement('button');

            b.type = 'button';
            b.className = 'cell';

            b.setAttribute('data-r', r);
            b.setAttribute('data-c', c);

            b.setAttribute(
                'aria-label',
                'Ô ' + (r + 1) + '-' + (c + 1)
            );

            if (board[r][c] !== 0) {

                b.classList.add(
                    board[r][c] === 1 ? 'p1' : 'p2'
                );

                b.textContent =
                    board[r][c] === 1 ? '✕' : '◯';
            }

            var isWin = winningCells.some(function (cell) {
                return cell[0] === r && cell[1] === c;
            });

            if (isWin) {
                b.classList.add('win');
            }

            b.addEventListener('click', onCellClick);

            fragment.appendChild(b);
        }
    }

    boardEl.appendChild(fragment);
}

// ========================================
// PLAYER LABELS
// ========================================

function updateLabels() {

    if (cur === 1) {

        p1label.classList.add('active');
        p2label.classList.remove('active');

    } else {

        p2label.classList.add('active');
        p1label.classList.remove('active');
    }
}

// ========================================
// CELL CLICK
// ========================================

function onCellClick() {

    if (finished) return;

    var r = Number(this.dataset.r);
    var c = Number(this.dataset.c);

    if (board[r][c] !== 0) return;

    board[r][c] = cur;

    this.classList.add(cur === 1 ? 'p1' : 'p2');

    this.textContent = cur === 1 ? '✕' : '◯';

    var winCells = checkWin(r, c, cur);

    if (winCells) {

        winningCells = winCells;

        for (var i = 0; i < winCells.length; i++) {

            var rr = winCells[i][0];
            var cc = winCells[i][1];

            var idx = rr * COLS + cc;

            if (boardEl.children[idx]) {
                boardEl.children[idx].classList.add('win');
            }
        }

        finished = true;

        setTimeout(function () {

            showWin(cur);
            startFireworks();

        }, 800);

        return;
    }

    cur = cur === 1 ? 2 : 1;

    updateLabels();
}

// ========================================
// CHECK WIN
// ========================================

function checkWin(r, c, p) {

    var dirs = [
        [1, 0],
        [0, 1],
        [1, 1],
        [1, -1]
    ];

    for (var i = 0; i < dirs.length; i++) {

        var dr = dirs[i][0];
        var dc = dirs[i][1];

        var count = 1;

        var cells = [[r, c]];

        var rr = r + dr;
        var cc = c + dc;

        while (
            inBounds(rr, cc) &&
            board[rr][cc] === p
        ) {

            cells.push([rr, cc]);

            count++;

            rr += dr;
            cc += dc;
        }

        rr = r - dr;
        cc = c - dc;

        while (
            inBounds(rr, cc) &&
            board[rr][cc] === p
        ) {

            cells.unshift([rr, cc]);

            count++;

            rr -= dr;
            cc -= dc;
        }

        if (count >= winLen) {
            return cells;
        }
    }

    return null;
}

// ========================================
// CHECK BOARD BOUNDARY
// ========================================

function inBounds(r, c) {

    return (
        r >= 0 &&
        r < ROWS &&
        c >= 0 &&
        c < COLS
    );
}

// ========================================
// WIN MODAL
// ========================================

function showWin(player) {

    modalTitle.textContent = 'Chúc mừng';

    modalMsg.textContent =
        'Người chơi ' + player + ' thắng!';

    overlay.classList.add('show');
}

// ========================================
// RESET GAME
// ========================================

function resetGame() {

    board = Array.from(
        { length: ROWS },
        function () {
            return Array(COLS).fill(0);
        }
    );

    finished = false;
    cur = 1;

    winningCells = [];

    updateLabels();

    createBoard();

    modalTitle.textContent = 'Chúc mừng';
    modalMsg.textContent = 'Người chơi x thắng!';
}

// ========================================
// RESTART BUTTON
// ========================================

restartBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {

    resetGame();

    stopFireworks();

    overlay.classList.remove('show');
});

// ========================================
// FIREWORKS CANVAS
// ========================================

var ctx;
var W = 0;
var H = 0;
var dpr = 1;

var particles = [];
var animId = null;

// ========================================
// SETUP CANVAS
// ========================================

function setupCanvas() {

    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 3);

    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;

    fxCanvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    fxCanvas.style.height = H + 'px';

    fxCanvas.width = Math.round(W * dpr);
    fxCanvas.height = Math.round(H * dpr);

    ctx = fxCanvas.getContext('2d');

    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
}

// ========================================
// START FIREWORKS
// ========================================

function startFireworks() {

    if (!ctx) {
        setupCanvas();
    }

    particles = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {

        launch(
            Math.random() * W * 0.8 + W * 0.1,
            Math.random() * H * 0.4 + H * 0.2
        );
    }

    if (!animId) {
        animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
}

// ========================================
// STOP FIREWORKS
// ========================================

function stopFireworks() {

    if (animId) {

        cancelAnimationFrame(animId);

        animId = null;
    }

    particles = [];

    if (ctx) {

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
}

// ========================================
// PARTICLE
// ========================================

function launch(x, y) {

    var hue = Math.random() * 360;

    for (var i = 0; i < 80; i++) {

        var angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

        var speed = Math.random() * 4 + 1;

        particles.push({

            x: x,
            y: y,

            vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
            vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,

            life: Math.random() * 60 + 30,
            age: 0,

            hue: hue
        });
    }
}

// ========================================
// ANIMATION LOOP
// ========================================

function loop() {

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    for (var i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

        var p = particles[i];

        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;

        p.vy += 0.04;

        p.age++;

        var alpha = Math.max(
            0,
            1 - p.age / p.life
        );

        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

        ctx.beginPath();

        ctx.arc(
            p.x,
            p.y,
            Math.max(1, 2 - p.age / 30),
            0,
            Math.PI * 2
        );

        ctx.fillStyle =
            'hsl(' + p.hue + ' ' +
            Math.floor(50 + alpha * 50) +
            '% 50%)';

        ctx.fill();

        if (p.age > p.life) {
            particles.splice(i, 1);
        }
    }

    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    if (particles.length > 0) {

        animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);

    } else {

        animId = null;
    }
}

// ========================================
// RESIZE EVENTS
// ========================================

window.addEventListener('resize', function () {

    resizeBoard();

    setupCanvas();
});

// ========================================
// RESTART SHORTCUT
// ========================================

document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {

    if (
        e.key.toLowerCase() === 'r' &&
        !e.ctrlKey &&
        !e.altKey &&
        !e.metaKey
    ) {

        if (e.target && e.target.isContentEditable) return;

        resetGame();

        stopFireworks();

        overlay.classList.remove('show');
    }
});

// ========================================
// DOUBLE CLICK RESTART
// ========================================

boardEl.addEventListener('dblclick', function () {

    if (confirm('Chơi lại?')) {

        resetGame();

        stopFireworks();

        overlay.classList.remove('show');
    }
});

// ========================================
// INIT
// ========================================

initBoardSize();

createBoard();

updateLabels();

setupCanvas();

</script>

</body>
</html>
